trigger.description: The workspace_id observed on lookup differs from the workspace_id captured in the persisted SRR6.46.13 discovery-cache entry (e.g. the operator pointed the same .ee/ directory at a different workspace registration, restored a backup taken under a different workspace identity, or the cache was copied across workspace roots). evaluate_discovery_cache returns DiscoveryCacheRefreshReason::WorkspaceMismatch at src/mesh/discovery_cache.rs:189-191, surfacing discovery_cache_stale_due_to_workspace_mismatch so callers know the cached peer set must not be trusted for the current workspace and a fresh probe will run.
setup_commands: ee mesh enable --workspace . --json   # populates the SRR6.46.13 discovery cache against wsp_alpha
ee workspace reregister --workspace . --new-id wsp_beta   # or restore .ee/ from a different workspace's backup
